samples.question: The image shows two separate dot-grid seals: a left seal made of amber and gray dots and a right seal made of amber and gray dots. Each seal is a 3-by-3 grid. Superimpose the two seals cell by cell (the XOR or difference of the two grids, the declared transform): a grid position counts as marked exactly when the left seal and the right seal disagree in colour at that cell (one amber, the other gray). The set of marked cells forms a symbol. Which symbol does the marked grid form?
